i_t_assibilation.description: A t-initial person-agreement marker surfaces as s after an i-final verb stem.
i_t_assibilation.source: Green & Morrison (2018), On the morphophonology of domains in Somali verbs and nouns, accepted manuscript pp. 23-24: kari+t+aa -> karisaa 'she cooks it'; the discussion states that t assibilates to s after an i-final verb stem and that this t agreement marker pertains to 2sg, 3sg feminine, and 2pl.

kari.class_evidence: Saeed (1999), Somali, uses kari as the Conjugation 2A example verb; Green & Morrison (2018) also treats kari as an i-final stem in its explicit assibilation example.
kari.development_evidence: Green & Morrison (2018) explicitly gives kari+t+aa -> karisaa and states that t-assibilation after i applies to the 2sg/3sg feminine/2pl t-agreement marker. This first runtime slice authorizes only the printed -t-aa surface shared by 2sg and 3sg feminine; 2pl remains ungenerated until its ending is separately reviewed.

benchmark_isolation.note: The runtime profile is authorized from Green & Morrison plus independent conjugation classification, not from any frozen benchmark answer. Generation is finite and lemma-specific.

notes: First Conjugation-2 morphophonology slice. Only kari present 2sg/3sg feminine is authorized. The runtime does not infer other i-final lemmas, does not reverse-strip -saa, and grants no correction authority.
